# Getting Started

## Install R packages





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, tsibble, feasts, fable, seasonal)
```
:::





Load in the dataset





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_data = read_csv("data/visitor_arrivals_by_air.csv")
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_data$`Month-Year`= dmy(ts_data$`Month-Year`)
```
:::

## Converting `tibble` object to `tsibble` object





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_tsibble <- ts_data %>%
  mutate(Month = yearmonth(`Month-Year`)) %>%
  as_tsibble(index = `Month`)
```
:::





# Visualising Time-series Data





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer <- ts_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::





## Visualising single time-series: ggplot2 methods





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ts_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
             y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::





## Plotting multiple time-series data with ggplot2 methods





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals,
           color = Country))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", 
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.5, "cm"))
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-8-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::





Trellis plot





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = ts_longer, 
       aes(x = `Month-Year`, 
           y = Arrivals))+
  geom_line(size = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ Country,
             ncol = 3,
             scales = "free_y") +
  theme_bw()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-9-1.png){width=672}

# Visual Analysis of Time-series Data with Seasonality





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer <- ts_tsibble %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(2:34),
               names_to = "Country",
               values_to = "Arrivals")
```
:::





## Visual Analysis of Seasonality with Seasonal Plot





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Italy" |
         Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "United Kingdom" |
         Country == "Germany") %>% 
  gg_season(Arrivals)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-11-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

# Visual Forecasting

## Time Series Data Sampling





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_ts <- tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam") %>% 
  mutate(Type = if_else(
    `Month-Year` >= "2019-01-01", 
    "Hold-out", "Training"))
```
:::





Filter for training dataset





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_train <- vietnam_ts %>%
  filter(`Month-Year` < "2019-01-01")
```
:::





## Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA): Time Series Data





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
vietnam_train %>%
  model(stl = STL(Arrivals)) %>%
  components() %>%
  autoplot()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In-class_Ex07_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-18-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::





## Fitting forecasting models





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
fit_ses <- vietnam_train %>%
  model(ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") 
            + trend("N") 
            + season("N")))
fit_ses
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
# A mable: 1 x 2
# Key:     Country [1]
  Country `ETS(Arrivals ~ error("A") + trend("N") + season("N"))`
  <chr>                                                   <model>
1 Vietnam                                            <ETS(A,N,N)>
```


:::
:::





Examine model assumptions





::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
gg_tsresiduals(fit_ses)
```
